description: Searched snapshots/s02 (only assigned tree) for consumers of skb->csum_start/skb->csum_offset/CHECKSUM_PARTIAL that dereference or do arithmetic on those values without re-validating against skb headroom/headlen. Finding: drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/fec_main.c lines 326-340, function fec_enet_clear_csum(), quote "\t*(__sum16 *)(skb->head + skb->csum_start + skb->csum_offset) = 0;" — a TX-path consumer that performs an unvalidated 16-bit kernel-memory WRITE at skb->head + csum_start + csum_offset on CHECKSUM_PARTIAL skbs (called from fec TX submit at line 453 and TSO path at line 691) with no bounds check in the function or callers, making any inconsistently validated producer (such as the seed's xsk_skb_metadata TOCTOU) into an out-of-bounds write; confidence medium because impact is contingent on the producer path. Safe classifications with concrete evidence: net/core/dev.c skb_checksum_help (BUG_ON headlen guards both uses), net/core/skbuff.c skb_partial_csum_set/skb_checksum_setup (validates csum_start/csum_end against U16_MAX and headlen), net/ipv4/fou.c GUE remcsum (checks csum_start < hdrlen, no deref), net/hsr/hsr_forward.c (only shifts csum_start by the headroom delta), net/can/gw.c (BUG_ON on non-UNNECESSARY ip_summed, no deref), tun/tap/vhost/af_packet vnet header paths (validate before skb_partial_csum_set). Bounded negative evidence: all grep-level csum_start consumers in net/ and drivers/net/ were enumerated; remaining limitations are that driver descriptor-programming consumers (bcmsysport, igb/ixgbe, cassini, sungem, sunhme, ll_temac, axienet, skge, sunvnet) were inspected at grep level only, and producer-side files (tcp_offload, sctp, ipvs, netfilter SYNPROXY/NAT) were classified as producers rather than memory-dereferencing consumers without full reads. Final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i009.json with snapshots_checked=["s02"], execution_status=complete.
